title: OfficeGoods Liberty Pro Electric Stapler - Jam-Free, Heavy Duty, 25 Sheet Capacity - Easy to Load, Battery Operated
description:
About This Item

Introducing the OfficeGoods Liberty Pro Electric Stapler - Your Perfect Stapling Solution for Home and Office. Say goodbye to frustrating jams and hello to hassle-free stapling with the Liberty Pro 25 electric stapler. This high-quality stapler is an essential addition to your office desk accessories, ensuring smooth and consistent stapling without interruption. Designed with premium eco-friendly materials, the Liberty Pro 25 is built to last. It effortlessly staples up to 25 sheets of 20 lb.

paper, making it the ideal tool for all your stapling needs. Whether you're working on school projects, executive reports, or home office tasks, this stapler delivers top-notch performance every time. With the Liberty Pro 25, you'll always be ready to go. It comes with a full strip of standard staples already loaded, so you can start stapling right away.

Plus, it offers versatility by allowing you to power it either with the included AC adapter or 6 AA batteries (not included). This makes it perfect for both stationary and on-the-go stapling. No more guesswork when it comes to staple placement. The Liberty Pro 25 features a staple depth adjuster, allowing you to precisely position your staples exactly where you need them.

Choose from 14 different positions, with intervals ranging from .25 inches to 1.5 inches. This ensures that your stapling is always neat and professional. Invest in the OfficeGoods Liberty Pro Electric Stapler and experience the freedom of jam-free, heavy-duty stapling. With its portable and compact design, this stapler is perfect for any workspace, whether it's a busy office or a cozy home office.

Get yours today and revolutionize your stapling experience.
